extracted.stage: Pre-grant; grant of probate expected within 16 weeks, property to be sold
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £1,977,000 Reading estate enquires about an £81,000 probate loan for professional fees and tax pending sale of the property.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding the executors of the Reading estate. To take this further we would need confirmation of the executors' details and their consent, a breakdown of the estate assets and liabilities with supporting valuations, the expected inheritance tax position and any relevant deadlines, and details of the property to be sold including any existing charges. Please also confirm the status of the grant application and your firm's engagement with the executors. Once we have those documents we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
